title: Resolution urging Albany to protect SCRIE/DRIE after temporary income spikes
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.4252/A.10721. The bill would let seniors and people with disabilities keep their Senior Citizen Rent Increase Exemption or Disability Rent Increase Exemption benefits after a temporary period of ineligibility caused by a one-time increase in a household head's income. It aims to prevent loss of these rent-freeze protections due to short-term income changes like pension adjustments or emergency withdrawals.
